GamerAccounting and Business Central are read-only. Corpus persistence is false. /app is unchanged. No restart, SharePoint move/upload, Mongo mutation, BC write, or Production routing authority is permitted.

next_after_success: If V117 reaches zero wrong automatic routes, 100% automatic accuracy, and at least 90% heldout coverage, integrate the learned AP router shadow-first in UAT while the deterministic route remains authoritative and accumulate real intake telemetry. Production remains untouched until explicit authorization.
notes: Detailed V115/V116 history remains preserved in Git history. V117 REV1 measured 25 holdouts, 11 auto-routes, 14 reviews, 44% coverage, 90.91% auto accuracy, and one wrong auto-route; runtime authority remained blocked. REV1 also exposed a severe evaluation infrastructure defect: 116 of 149 targeted expansion hydrations failed after Mongo DNS loss, causing long opaque runtime and starving the expanded corpus. REV2 keeps every promotion threshold unchanged, adds a narrow fail-closed warehouse-reference-versus-Tooling safety overlay, adds evaluation-only live-BC fallback after Mongo failure, and emits expansion progress every ten completions.
